animationScaleHint: Length of the zoom and pan glide. 0 is instant, 1 is 100 ms, 3 is 300 ms.
clearLogsHint: Deletes every retained log file and starts a fresh one. Cannot be undone.
copyLogFilesHint: Puts the log files themselves on the clipboard so you can paste them straight into a report as attachments. Pasting the text instead would be unreadable at this size.
copyLogsHint: Copies the environment plus the tail of both logs as text, capped so it stays pasteable. Use the button above for anything you intend to attach.
diagCaptureHint: Samples held, the sample rate they were taken at, and the time span they cover.
diagDrawPathsHint: Waveform draws recorded since load and the most-used path. Only recorded in development builds.
diagFrameLoopHint: Whether the backend frame loop is wired for this session and has produced a frame yet. The loop owns the viewport while a capture is loaded.
diagMemoryHint: Memory used by the loaded capture against the configured capture memory limit.
gridLinesHint: Draw the time grid behind the waveform. Turn it off for a cleaner trace when reading values by eye.
logDefaultLevelHint: Verbosity for every module that has no level of its own, in both the webview and the backend log. Debug and trace stay in the webview buffer; only info and above reach the log file.
logModuleHint: Overrides the default level for one part of the app. A module you leave alone follows the default, so raise only the one you are chasing.
logPausedHint: Stop writing logs to disk. Turn it on only if you need the machine quiet; recording is bounded and on by default so the run that breaks is already captured.
logUsageHint: How much the retained log files take against the hard cap. Each launch gets its own file, capped in size, and the oldest are deleted.
matchChannelColorsHint: Draw digital and analog channels in the same colour.
panToTriggerHint: Move the view to the trigger when a capture arrives.
renameTabToSavedCaptureHint: Use the saved file name as the session tab title.
resetAllHint: Restores every option on this panel to its default value.
saveLogsHint: Writes the same bundle to a file you choose, for report trackers that want an attachment.
